source_contracts.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED (historical 1996-12-31 to 2026-02-06 segment sourced via a third-party GitHub archive, github.com/maaurocp/Trading_Protocol, commit bf64e83, since FRED itself began restricting BAMLH0A0HYM2 to a rolling 3-year window starting April 2026, per FRED's own series-page notice: "Starting in April 2026, this series will only include 3 years of observations. For more data, go to the source."; the 2026-02-07 onward segment is this project's own direct FRED pull, unchanged from the prior snapshot)
source_contracts.dataset: ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread
source_contracts.vintage_policy: Content-addressed snapshot; refresh requires a new dataset_version and hashes before release.
source_contracts.freshness_rule: Refresh after each completed expected session; fail closed when the declared threshold is exceeded.
source_contracts.missing_rule: Required-input failure propagates null with reason; no silent fill.
source_contracts.splice_policy: No silent source splice within a published dataset version. NOTE: this specific snapshot IS a two-source splice by necessity (see provider field) — recorded here explicitly per that same no-silent-splice discipline, not silently done. The join was verified before adoption: the two segments' only overlapping date range (2023-08-25 to 2026-02-06, 651 observations) was checked value-by-value and found to match exactly (formatting differences like "3.9" vs "3.90" aside), and the boundary date (2026-02-06) itself matches between both segments.
source_contracts.refresh_policy: Run the versioned updater after each completed session; recompute hashes and bump dataset_version before adoption. Future refreshes of the RECENT tail (post-2026-02-06) may continue to use the existing FRED CSV endpoint (still live for the rolling 3-year window); refreshing the pre-2023-08-25 historical segment, if ever needed again, requires locating a new independent archive, since FRED itself no longer serves it.
source_contracts.notes: Re-sourced 2026-08-28 (Message[193]) to extend real coverage from 2023-08-25 back to 1996-12-31, fixing the OAS-coverage-length constraint that blocked Risk Appetite/Condition availability before 2025-07-29 (Message[190]/[191]). Verified against 3 known historical extremes before adoption: 2007-06-01 trough 2.41% (matches), 2008-12-12 GFC peak 21.3% (matches), 2020-03-23 COVID-crash level 10.87% (in the expected 10-11% range) — all independently corroborated by public web sources before this file was trusted.
source_contracts.observation_timestamp_policy: CSV observation_date identifies the economic observation date; no intraday observation time is asserted.
source_contracts.publication_timestamp_policy: The CSV snapshot lacks per-row publication timestamps; retrieval timestamp is recorded by provenance, and same-day availability is not assumed.
source_contracts.availability_lag: Conservative T+1 business-day rule: an observation is usable no earlier than 00:00 America/Chicago on the next FRED business day.
source_contracts.point_in_time_join_rule: Join to the first XNYS session whose open occurs after the conservative availability timestamp; never join on observation_date itself.
source_contracts.price_field_policy: Not a price series: canonical calculations MUST read the BAMLH0A0HYM2 percent-spread column keyed by observation_date.
source_contracts.corporate_action_policy: Corporate actions are not applicable. FRED/ICE BofA revisions change the snapshot hash and require a new dataset_version before adoption.
